subject: general
question: In which year did the Delhi High Court issue a notice regarding a plea for 33% reservation for women lawyers in Bar Council elections?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2024**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Delhi High Court issued a notice regarding a plea for 33% reservation for women lawyers in Bar Council elections in **2024**.
 
• This plea was aimed at increasing the representation of women in the Bar Council, ensuring gender diversity.
 
• The notice by the Delhi High Court signifies the judiciary's recognition of the need for gender equality in legal bodies.
 
• This move is part of broader efforts to promote women's participation in various professional fields, including law.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bar Council of India (BCI)**

 
 
• The BCI is a statutory body that regulates legal practice and legal education in India.
 
• It was established under the Advocates Act, 1961.
 
• The BCI sets standards for legal education and grants recognition to universities whose degree in law will serve as a qualification for enrollment as an advocate.
 
• The BCI also conducts the All India Bar Examination (AIBE) for law graduates before they can practice law in India.
 
 
 
• **Reservation for Women**
 
 
• Reservation for women is a policy measure aimed at ensuring representation and participation of women in various sectors.
 
• It is implemented in education, employment, and political bodies to address gender disparities.
 
• In the context of the Bar Council elections, it aims to provide women lawyers with opportunities to participate in decision-making processes.
 
• Such measures are crucial for achieving gender equality and empowering women in professional fields.
 
 
 
• **Delhi High Court**
 
 
• The Delhi High Court is one of the prominent high courts in India and exercises jurisdiction over the National Capital Territory of Delhi.
 
• It was established on 31 October 1966.
 
• The court has the authority to hear appeals from lower courts and also has original jurisdiction in certain cases.
 
• It plays a crucial role in the administration of justice and upholding the rule of law in the capital region.
